definition.purpose: Goal 062 is complete and Claude has independently verified it (board thread 86). The roadmap leaves Paper 1's breadth to you: write on the current fixed-design claims, or first address one of the remaining gaps. Your answers set Astra's next tranche. When you submit, Claude will post your exact answers on the board for Astra.

questions.context: The interval check fits each of the 3,000 positive-effect Goal 062 histories once more, with h fixed at its true value. That directly measures how often the standard likelihood interval for h contains the truth. It needs no new simulation: under an hour of Deep compute plus a small implementation and audit. Goal 062 showed that point estimates of h are poor at low background hazard, so the paper currently has no interval for effect size.

options.label: Start writing Paper 1 on the current fixed-design claims, with no further experiments
Run the interval-coverage check on the existing Goal 062 histories first, then start writing
Plan a broader tranche (chosen below) before writing

questions.prompt: What should happen next for Paper 1?

questions.context: Planning only: nothing launches without your approval. Landscape generality needs an accepted numerical integration method first, then roughly 40 hours of Deep compute per added map. A common competing-process model set means models able to represent the B100-A background, so the generating family can be formally discriminated.

options.label: Landscape generality: repeat the evaluation on new maps
Common competing-process models, including one that can represent B100-A
Neither for now; state the claim boundary in Paper 1 and leave both to a later paper

questions.prompt: Which broader charter gaps should be costed and planned now, for Paper 1 or a later paper?
